parameters.query: SELECT $1::text AS content_hash, $2::text AS prompt_version, $3::text AS model, $4::text AS posting_id, $5::text AS company, $6::text AS role, $7::text AS location, $8::text AS employment_type, $9::text AS apply_url, $10::text AS source, $11::numeric AS notify_min_score, $12::text AS system_message, $13::text AS user_message, e.match_score AS cached_match_score, e.should_apply AS cached_should_apply, e.reason AS cached_reason, e.missing_skills AS cached_missing_skills, e.deadline AS cached_deadline, e.eligibility AS cached_eligibility, e.ctc_or_stipend AS cached_ctc_or_stipend, e.invalid AS cached_invalid, (e.content_hash IS NOT NULL) AS cache_hit FROM (SELECT 1) AS dummy LEFT JOIN evaluations e ON e.content_hash = $1 AND e.prompt_version = $2 AND e.model = $3

parameters.jsCode:
const j = $json;
return {
  json: {
    content_hash: j.content_hash,
    prompt_version: j.prompt_version,
    model: j.model,
    posting_id: j.posting_id,
    company: j.company,
    role: j.role,
    location: j.location,
    employment_type: j.employment_type,
    apply_url: j.apply_url,
    source: j.source,
    notify_min_score: j.notify_min_score,
    match_score: j.cached_match_score,
    should_apply: j.cached_should_apply,
    reason: j.cached_reason,
    missing_skills: JSON.stringify(j.cached_missing_skills || []),
    deadline: j.cached_deadline || null,
    eligibility: j.cached_eligibility || null,
    ctc_or_stipend: j.cached_ctc_or_stipend || null,
    input_tokens: 0,
    output_tokens: 0,
    cost_usd: 0,
    invalid: j.cached_invalid,
    cache_hit: true
  }
};

const j = $json;
const costUsd = (j.input_tokens || 0) / 1e6 * 1.00 + (j.output_tokens || 0) / 1e6 * 5.00;
return {
  json: {
    content_hash: j.content_hash,
    prompt_version: j.prompt_version,
    model: j.model,
    posting_id: j.posting_id,
    company: j.company,
    role: j.role,
    location: j.location,
    employment_type: j.employment_type,
    apply_url: j.apply_url,
    source: j.source,
    notify_min_score: j.notify_min_score,
    match_score: j.match_score,
    should_apply: j.should_apply,
    reason: j.reason,
    missing_skills: JSON.stringify(j.missing_skills || []),
    deadline: j.deadline || null,
    eligibility: j.eligibility || null,
    ctc_or_stipend: j.ctc_or_stipend || null,
    input_tokens: j.input_tokens,
    output_tokens: j.output_tokens,
    cost_usd: Math.round(costUsd * 1e6) / 1e6,
    invalid: false,
    cache_hit: false
  }
};

parameters.query: INSERT INTO evaluations (content_hash, prompt_version, model, match_score, should_apply, reason, missing_skills, deadline, eligibility, ctc_or_stipend, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd, invalid) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::jsonb, $8, $9, $10, $11, $12, $13, $14) ON CONFLICT (content_hash, prompt_version, model) DO UPDATE SET created_at = evaluations.created_at RETURNING content_hash, prompt_version, model, match_score, should_apply, reason, missing_skills, deadline, eligibility, ctc_or_stipend, invalid
INSERT INTO runs (workflow, started_at, finished_at, fetched, prefiltered, llm_calls, cache_hits, notified, cost_usd) VALUES ('WF-2', now(), now(), $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6) RETURNING id
